description: Get the real-time operational status of major AI services (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, Cohere, Replicate, Hugging Face), including per-component breakdowns and an operational/degraded/down rollup per provider. One cross-provider status call instead of checking each vendor's status page, useful before an agent routes a request to a model that may be impaired. Free, no auth.
name: get_ai_status
